title: Components of a low degree projection
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, and let $\Omega=\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\Omega_i$ be its outcome space. For every $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, every $k\in\mathbb N$, every function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and every $x\in\Omega$, the $S$-component of the low degree projection of $f$ at $x$ equals the $S$-component of $f$ at $x$ when $|S|\le k$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a product of $n$ finite probability spaces
Every atom mass is strictly positive and each coordinate's masses sum to one
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $S\subseteq[n]$, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The $S$-component of $f^{\le k}$ equals $f_S$ if $|S|\le k$, and zero otherwise.
